decision: GO qualified for bounded research and first proof; no implementation success claimed

validation.basis: Static source/test review and primary-source browsing; no fresh application pass.

recommendations.proposal: Keep authored AnalysisQuery; add a narrow typed read/demand boundary over its output relation.
recommendations.rationale: Transient reads must preserve authored row meaning and stage inspection.
recommendations.costs: Consumer adaptation and explicit admission; no second general planner.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Fetch complete source snapshots and retain all local analysis/stage inspection.

confidence.basis: Existing authored/view separation is explicit; remote seam remains a proposal.

proof.method: P1: bar/scatter/Rows interaction trace plus query-definition comparison.
proof.reject_if: Ordinary selection or paging rewrites authored steps or changes output grain.

recommendations.proposal: Name selected, owner-excluded context, workspace, local and facet populations explicitly.
recommendations.rationale: One predicate erases owner context and broadcasts local restrictions.
recommendations.costs: Several effective scopes and stable domain/bin descriptors.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Keep all Crossfilter population computation local on a complete snapshot.

confidence.basis: Wrapper/tests establish owner exclusion; absent callers limit facet/domain compatibility.

proof.method: P1: select/clear, two owners on one field, local restrictions, facets and bin edges.
proof.reject_if: Any selected/context/Rows membership or trace membership differs from the declared scope.

recommendations.proposal: Start with complete projected output rows when the named workload fits its budget.
recommendations.rationale: Complete required fields enable exact local selection and clear without data requests.
recommendations.costs: Transfer, hydration, indexes and old/new overlap grow with rows and width.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Complete source snapshots preserve more inspection with fewer semantic changes.

confidence.basis: Correctness basis is clear; device, width and acceptable budgets are unmeasured.

proof.method: P1: compare 10k/100k narrow and wide complete-source/projected paths.
proof.reject_if: Correctness fails or the projected path misses predeclared latency/memory budgets without a material benefit.

recommendations.proposal: Certify complete row regions and fields independently; unknown containment is a cache miss.
recommendations.rationale: Rows outside coverage and unloaded fields cannot be evaluated as known data.
recommendations.costs: Coverage metadata, key alignment and eviction invalidation.
recommendations.serious_alternative: One complete base projection; refresh the union projection on every field miss.

confidence.basis: Exact local evaluation requires complete relevant inputs; general predicate implication is deferred.

proof.method: P1: West-only cache, East/clear requests, missing fields, wrong-snapshot columns and eviction.
proof.reject_if: Any missing row/field or retired certificate permits an exhaustive exact local answer.

recommendations.proposal: Enable bounded server aggregates/pages only for a measured failing workload or required access pattern.
recommendations.rationale: Compact groups/pages reduce bytes but cannot replace exhaustive raw populations.
recommendations.costs: Consumer paths, server latency, cursors and evidence reads.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Continue complete projected rows if the simpler path meets the workload.

confidence.basis: Useful shape options; no measured need or provider parity yet.

proof.method: Conditional follow-up: compare a failing workload with exact aggregate/page mode and source-bound trace.
proof.reject_if: Benefits do not address the measured bottleneck, or order, pooling, eligibility or trace changes meaning.

recommendations.proposal: Separate request relevance, semantic reuse, actual snapshot and freshness; admit batches atomically.
recommendations.rationale: Request IDs do not prove source consistency; abort does not replace reply validation.
recommendations.costs: Applied/pending state, bounded staging and batch-only full refresh.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Immutable fixture and one foreground full refresh; no retained snapshots.

confidence.basis: Local identity limits and database snapshot lifetime are documented.

proof.method: P1: reorder, ignore abort, fail, expire, truncate and change source/schema mid-flight.
proof.reject_if: Old or mixed-snapshot data becomes current, or prior data is relabeled with desired scope.

recommendations.proposal: Declare supported value, step and key semantics; preserve analysis and chart value layers.
recommendations.rationale: Analysis comparisons, chart parsing, lookup grain and entity measures need explicit parity.
recommendations.costs: Capability errors and hand-audited parity fixtures.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Run existing calculations/joins locally on complete source inputs.

confidence.basis: Material semantic differences are visible; missing calculator internals limit translation claims.

proof.method: P1/P2: null/undefined, numeric text, dates, duplicate keys, ambiguous lookup and entity conflicts.
proof.reject_if: Unsupported or changed semantics produce an admitted exact result instead of an explicit error.

recommendations.proposal: Use bounded snapshot-bound evidence requests for aggregate marks and analysis stages.
recommendations.rationale: Contributor arrays defeat compact aggregates; omitted evidence is not empty evidence.
recommendations.costs: Handle lifetime, ordered pages and pooled re-aggregation.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Keep local contributor arrays with complete sources while they fit the budget.

confidence.basis: Provenance dependency is explicit; trace consumers are partly absent from the packet.

proof.method: Trace an old mark after refresh/expiry; pool equal-valued overlapping entities.
proof.reject_if: Trace silently reads newer rows, omitted evidence appears empty, or pooling double-counts entities.

recommendations.proposal: Combine exact-compatible demands and union projections with direct control flow.
recommendations.rationale: Compatible reads may share work while retaining separate owner subscriptions.
recommendations.costs: Canonical descriptions, dependency closure and consumer routing.
recommendations.serious_alternative: One complete base projection serves all views locally without remote coalescing.

confidence.basis: Demand consolidation is established; the proposed subset is deliberately small.

proof.method: Two compatible scatters share columns; brushes, cursors and entity/bin rules force splits.
proof.reject_if: Deduplication merges incompatible scope/order/page semantics or one cancellation removes another consumer's work.

recommendations.proposal: Prove behavior with a deterministic fake, then one bounded immutable database fixture.
recommendations.rationale: Controlled failed/reordered/incomplete replies can reject the design before driver work.

repository_evidence.symbol: Before claiming anything, Measure in the page

recommendations.costs: Runnable checkout, fixture and agreed measurement environment.
recommendations.serious_alternative: A broad live-adapter prototype; weaker isolation and unnecessary initial access/setup.

confidence.basis: Existing fake shows the seam; no implementation or fresh passes are claimed.

proof.method: P1 manual reply queue and hand-audited oracle; P2 read-only fixture; measure 10k/100k width matrix.
proof.reject_if: Any semantic mismatch, unbounded memory, incomplete admission or failure of the ratified workload target occurs.

recommendations.proposal: Defer a general optimizer, arbitrary SQL, universal translation, retained mutable snapshots and progressive region caches.
recommendations.rationale: One visible proof precedes maintaining several execution systems.
recommendations.costs: Some operations remain unsupported or require full refresh.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Adopt a general coordinator or retained-cache service only for demonstrated repeated expensive demand.

confidence.basis: Scope supports simplicity; future workloads are unknown.

proof.method: Run the complete-source/projected policy comparison and attribute any failure.
proof.reject_if: A required named workload fails the simpler path and a bounded experiment shows deferred machinery fixes that failure.

recommendations.proposal: Reject silent truncation, unloaded-as-null fields, partial-as-complete caches, exact-labeled previews and unstable page identity.
recommendations.rationale: These substitutions silently change membership, totals, clear behavior or identity.
recommendations.costs: Explicit limit/incomplete/unsupported states with honest prior scope.
recommendations.serious_alternative: Offer an explicitly bounded page/preview whose limited scope is part of its result contract.

confidence.basis: Exactness depends on stated coverage, value meaning and stable keys.

proof.method: P1: truncate, omit fields, reorder duplicate-key pages and clear outside a cached subset.
proof.reject_if: Any prohibited reply is admitted as a complete exact population or its keys misidentify a record.

handoff.transport: Preserve identities, scalars, keys, domains/bins, coverage and terminal completion; bound staging and expose sizes. Encoding remains track 2.
handoff.adapter: Validate definitions/bindings and step semantics; declare schema/grain/keys, snapshot lifetime, caps and cancellation. Implementation remains track 3.

unresolved_assumptions: Immediate full stage inspection may favor complete source snapshots.
Representative widths, device and budgets require measurement.
Adapter/transport determine snapshot reuse and scalar/collation/calculation support.
Absent helpers/callers limit full facet, bin, trace and expression parity.
